anomalies.description: A man (Matt Damon) delivers a forceful punch to another man's face, causing visible impact and recoil.

A man (older, in suit) is shown with a bloody nose and facial contusions, head tilted back, mouth open, appearing dazed or injured; another person (partially visible, left) is positioned close, suggesting he has just been struck or is being held.

The older man recovers slightly, eyes open, looking toward the other person; the second man (Matt Damon) appears in frame f6 onward with intense expression, suggesting an ongoing physical confrontation or imminent escalation.
The older man is grabbed by the collar/neck area (visible in f11–f12), with his hand clutching his own chest/throat, indicating he is being choked or restrained forcefully by the other person.
